summary: Pemagatshel district is overwhelmingly forested, covering 933.56 km² (91.2 %) of its territory. Agriculture occupies a modest 46.05 km² (4.5 %), while shrubs cover 30.28 km² (3.0 %). Water bodies, built‑up areas, landslides, sandy banks and other land‑use types each account for less than 0.6 % of the district.
